einzeiler: The rise and fall of John DeLorean, his iconic car, and a massive government-funded…
kurzfassung: John DeLorean left a successful career at General Motors to build his dream sports car with distinctive gull-wing doors and a stainless steel body. Securing massive funding from the UK government, he built a factory in troubled Northern Ireland, but the cars suffered from severe quality issues and financial fraud. The company collapsed in 1982 following DeLorean's infamous arrest in an FBI cocaine sting operation.
stichpunkte: John DeLorean rose through the ranks at General Motors, creating iconic cars like the Pontiac GTO before quitting in 1973.
He founded the DeLorean Motor Company to build an innovative sports car with stainless steel panels and gull-wing doors.
The UK government provided approximately 100 million dollars in grants and loans to build a factory in Dunmurry, Northern Ireland.
The factory faced immense challenges due to local sectarian violence, production delays, and heavy cost overruns.
Completed cars suffered from severe quality defects, leading to the creation of stateside quality assurance centers for constant repairs.
Financial investigations revealed millions in company funds were funneled through a shell company in Panama to a Swiss bank account.
DeLorean was arrested in October 1982 in a hotel room in an FBI sting operation involving a large quantity of cocaine.
He was later acquitted on entrapment charges, but the company went bankrupt and the car achieved legendary status years later via Back to the Future.

beschreibung:
This is a special crossover episode with Business History.
John DeLorean was a visionary who wanted to create a futuristic new sports car - a stainless steel marvel with distinctive gull-wing doors. The British Government agreed to finance the project, provided he built his factory in a troubled part of Northern Ireland. Production stumbled, sales fizzled and DeLorean liked to fiddle with the numbers. As the company approached ruin, a neighbour offered DeLorean a lifeline, if he'd only come in on a cocaine deal.
